Amilia is transforming the recreation and activities market with its innovative, purpose\-built SaaS platform. Designed for municipalities, community centers, nonprofits, businesses, and recreation organizations, **Amilia SmartRec™** streamlines operations, optimizes facility management, and simplifies program and membership management.


Since 2009, Amilia has been on a mission to revolutionize how communities connect and participate in activities. By combining cutting\-edge technology with deep industry expertise, the software empowers organizations to manage registrations, memberships, facilities, and finances more efficiently while enhancing community engagement.


Over 1,500 organizations across 6,600 locations in North America rely on Amilia to serve 4\.5 million participants and process $750M in transactions annually.


Caring is at the core of Amilia’s culture: for customers, tailored products, and colleagues alike. Driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for innovation, this mindset shapes everything we do.

  

Revenue Operations is a newly built function at Amilia, reporting to the COO, responsible for connecting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance into one operating system across the customer journey. Salesforce is our system of record, and RevOps owns every tool that touches it.

### **What you can expect:**


This is the first dedicated systems and tools hire inside RevOps. Reporting directly to the Director of Revenue Operations, you'll own the tools the GTM team runs on, and make them actually work: configuring the objects, building the flows, wiring the integrations, fixing the data, and using AI\-assisted development to move faster than a traditional admin queue allows.


Claude and Claude Code are already how this team builds, and you'll be expected to work the same way, not layer AI on as an afterthought.


You'll also help shape a function that's still being built: a RevOps team that already works AI\-natively, with the tooling and the mandate to use it, not just permission to ask. It's a category\-leading vertical\-SaaS environment with real technical depth in the systems you'd be running.

### **You will be responsible for:**

**Salesforce Administration**

* Declarative configuration: flows, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets, profiles, reports, and dashboards.
* User and license management, security review, and the field\-level hygiene that keeps Salesforce trustworthy as the system of record.
* Triage and close out the standing data\-quality and config backlog (duplicate records, broken flows, permission gaps, stale automation), work currently split between the Director and an external agency.
* Partner with the Director on architectural decisions such as object\-model changes and taxonomy rebuilds, and own the build, not just the ticket queue.

**Marketing \& GTM Tooling**

* Administer the martech stack RevOps is responsible for: HubSpot (workflows, lead scoring, campaign operations), Chili Piper (lead routing), Propensity (ABM), Fathom, RocketLane, CLM/quoting tools, and the sales\-engagement and cadence tooling inside Salesforce.
* Keep every tool's integration back to Salesforce clean. Salesforce is the hub, so nothing you administer should create a parallel data store.
* Support tool evaluation and pilots: set up trials, define what “pass” looks like, and carry a pilot into permanent operation once it earns its place in the stack.

**Data \& Reporting Infrastructure**

* Own the connective tissue between Salesforce, the marketing stack, and the reporting layer: keeping syncs, exports, and integrations running, and diagnosing them fast with the analytics engineer when they break.
* Build, maintain, and simplify the Salesforce reports, dashboards, and light data pipelines RevOps and its stakeholders depend on day to day, and support the shift to our “source of truth” cloud data\-lake reporting system as we build it out in 2027\.
* Work alongside the data/analytics function on schema and warehouse questions without owning deep analytics engineering. This is the operational admin seat, not the data\-architect seat.

**AI\-Native Systems Work**

* Use Claude and Claude Code as a standard part of how you build and maintain configuration: SFDX metadata changes, bulk data fixes, scripted QA, and automation that a point\-and\-click admin workflow would make too slow or too manual to attempt.
* Bring judgment about what to automate and what not to. AI makes bad changes cheap to ship, so config changes still get scoped, tested, and reviewed like engineering work, not shipped straight to production.

### **What we want from you:**

* 2 to 4 years of hands\-on Salesforce administration (Sales Cloud). Salesforce Administrator certification preferred, not required.
* Hands\-on, shippable experience with at least one AI coding/automation tool (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as a real part of your workflow today. This is a must\-have, not a nice\-to\-have, and you can point to something you've actually shipped with one.
* Experience administering at least one marketing automation or sales\-engagement platform (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesloft, Pardot, or similar).
* Comfortable writing basic SQL for data checks and light scripting for automation.
* You've administered Salesforce for real users in production, not a sandbox project, and you know the line between what's safe to build declaratively and what needs escalation.
* You default to fixing the data and the configuration, not building a report on top of the problem.
* You're comfortable inheriting and prioritizing your own backlog; this role starts with significant standing technical debt, not a clean system.

* Bonus: exposure to a CPQ/quoting tool, a contract lifecycle management (CLM) tool, or a data warehouse/BI layer.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1974, CMiC today delivers comprehensive and advanced enterprise and field operations solutions, purpose\-built for construction and capital projects companies. CMiC’s powerful software transforms how firms optimize productivity, minimize risk and drive growth by planning and managing all financials, projects, resources, and content assets \- all from a single database platform.


In the past several years, the construction industry has experienced unprecedented changes driven by new technologies \- including integration with multi\-dimensional modeling, an explosion of cloud\-based offerings and the demand for robust mobile capabilities. CMiC has kept pace by constantly upgrading and enhancing our advanced platform to reflect the changing needs of the industry, *leading to significant growth as a company.*

The overall hiring salary range for this position is $45,000 to $55,000 annually.


This position is for an existing vacancy


We do not use AI to screen, assess, or select applicants

We are seeking enthusiastic, talented people to ***act as the first point of contact when our customers have inquiries or encounter issues as they use our software****.*


**Product Analysts** receive tickets and analyze screenshots and details of customer issues, to replicate the problem while proactively communicating with CMiC teams to guide issues to resolution. In addition to providing a very high level of client service, you will develop strong relationships with clients and staff and provide feedback on documentation. Individuals applying for this position must be able to multi\-task, have a strong attention to detail, professional demeanor, and be able to adapt into a growing and changing environment.

* Triage product queues and prioritize issues according to their severity

* Test and duplicate issues in order to document and demonstrate the problem to other teams such as programming
* Participate in project and team meetings; interacting and collaborating with team members
* Leverage and contribute to the Knowledge Base to assist with the resolution of issues
* Relay feedback to Product Managers so that the product can be improved
* Provide feedback to supervisors and managers regarding processes that are unclear and need to be changed

**This role is for you if:**

* You would rather spend most of your time on challenging issues rather than handling simple support requests
* You want to engage in a collaborative environment with helpful co\-workers and accessible leaders and managers
* You prefer to work for a company that listens to its staff and continues to work toward being a Great Place To Work

* **French language skill (spoken and written) is a must**

* Excellent communication skills, both verbal \& written
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills
* A passion for exploring new software, ability to grasp new concepts and learn quickly
* Extremely detail oriented with the ability to manage and prioritize workflow
* Facilitate communication of information between team members and Product Groups
* Previous technical support experience or customer service experience
* Able to operate in a fast\-paced environment
* Team\-player, strong work ethic and a positive attitude

* Competitive benefits Package (including Health \& Dental benefits)

* An active Social Events Committee (past events include annual seasonal parties, pool and bowling tournaments, karaoke nights, Game nights, BBQs, and more)

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast\-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge technologies and continuous advancements. * ITIL Foundations certification.

Background or experience in food safety, quality assurance, or another regulated compliance domain (HACCP, SQF, BRC, etc.)

Experience delivering software training to groups

Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) in production workflows with human review

You'll work in a small tech team alongside our existing IT teammate, who covers a lot of the day\-to\-day support and hardware ground with you, and you'll partner closely with our maintenance and operations teams. * Write things down. SOPs, documentation, and training resources, so our systems are operable by more than one person including the tools you build

  


**Required Skills and Qualifications**


* Comfort working with APIs, data, and other people's systems reading documentation, handling auth, dealing with formats that clash, and getting two platforms to talk
* Enough hands\-on technical range to be comfortable with hardware, workstations, and admin consoles, and the proven ability to learn when confronted with something new
* The independence to locate issues and work without a roadmap.
* Access to reliable transportation; this role is based out of our head office but requires regular travel to our locations across the GTA

  


**The X\-Factor (What Really Gets Us Excited)**


* You fix things permanently. When something breaks twice, you treat the second time as a design problem, not a support ticket
* You automate yourself out of your own busy work, and then go find more interesting problems to work on
* You think in systems and SOPs, not heroics. The goal isn't to be the only person who knows how something works
* You're equally happy in a terminal window, in a network closet, and in a meeting with senior leadership

  


**Here's what you get from us**


* Real autonomy over the entire technology environment of a vertically integrated dessert company, and unusual freedom to decide what to build
* Variety no two days are the same, and the surface area is genuinely large
* Ownership you can point at. The tools you build here will be used by hundreds of people, daily, for years
* A collaborative, no\-politics environment with a small senior team
* Working for a brand that delivers happiness (people gush when you tell them where you work)
* A healthy and flexible work\-life balance, with a supportive management team

  



Our Corporate Head Office is in Vaughan, located on Strada Drive near Highway 7 \& Pine Valley (close to Hwy 400 \& Hwy 407\). This role is full time and predominantly based out of our head office, and will require visits to our Demetres and Scooped by Demetres locations across the GTA.

 **To Apply**



Please submit a resume and a brief cover letter where you tell us a little about what you'd like to bring to our small team. If you've built internal tools, automations, scripts, or documentation you're proud of, show us — a repo, a screenshot, a description of the problem and what you did about it. Anything that will tell us more than a list of technologies. Fit matters to us, as we know having the right person will make a world of difference.

  

Thank you!

About the Position

Niagara Belco Elevator Inc. is hiring an **Stairlift Diagnostics \& Field Support Technician** to serve as the technical backbone for our installation and service teams. This is a hands\-on, electromechanical role focused on fault\-finding and remote diagnostic support for stairlifts, vertical platform lifts, and related accessibility equipment.

The work is roughly two\-thirds electrical (control systems, wiring, power) and one\-third mechanical (drives, motors, rails). You will spend your day helping technicians on site solve real\-world equipment problems, not answering computer or software questions.

* Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, exploded views, and manufacturer service manuals

What We're Looking For

* Proven electrical fault\-finding skills with low\-voltage systems, controls, and wiring
* Solid mechanical aptitude, including motors, moving assemblies, alignment, and wear parts
* Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and mechanical drawings
* Clear communicator who can guide a technician through a repair over the phone
* Patient, methodical approach to troubleshooting
* Comfortable supporting trades professionals in the field rather than end users
* Hands\-on experience with stairlifts, elevators, platform lifts, escalators, or similar electromechanical equipment is a strong asset

This Role Is NOT

* IT or desktop support
* Helpdesk or software troubleshooting
* Network, server, or application support

**Position:** Systems Administrator
  
**Position Type:** Full time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy)
  
**Location:** Greater Toronto area, Canada (Hybrid with Regular Onsite Presence and Travel Requirements)
  
  

**The Company:**  

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award\-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it.
  
This exceptional content, reach and scope offers advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

The Systems Administrator, supporting Postmedia Distribution Services, provides leadership and hands\-on support for enterprise applications, end\-user services and related business technology. The role is responsible for improving how the organization works through process improvement, training, automation and practical technology solutions, while increasing service quality, strengthening security and controlling operating costs.
  
This position connects business departments, internal IT teams, senior leadership and external partners. The successful candidate will translate business requirements into supportable solutions, maintain reliable day\-to\-day services and lead technology change from discovery through implementation and ongoing support.
  
The position combines people leadership, business relationship management, operational support, application ownership and project delivery responsibilities in a fast\-paced national environment.
  
  

Work Environment, Travel and Operational Support Requirements
  
* Regular onsite attendance is an essential requirement of this position. The Systems Administrator is expected to maintain an active presence within company locations to support employees, build strong business relationships and provide leadership for operational, support and project activities.
* This is a hybrid position. While remote\-work flexibility is available, the successful candidate will be expected to work onsite regularly based on operational requirements, project demands, employee support needs and leadership priorities.
* Periodic travel to company offices, production facilities, distribution locations, vendor sites and partner locations is required.
* The role operates within a geographically distributed organization and supports multiple locations, business units, operating companies and external service providers across Canada.
* As the senior escalation point for business applications, support services and operational technology issues, the Systems Administrator participates in an on\-call rotation and must be available to respond to significant service disruptions, major incidents and business\-critical issues when required.
* Periodic after\-hours work is expected to support upgrades, maintenance activities, technology deployments, migrations, cutovers, system testing, disaster recovery exercises and other activities that cannot be performed during normal business hours.
* The position requires flexibility to work evenings and weekends when necessary to maintain service continuity, support operational requirements and deliver key business initiatives.


**What you’ll do:**  

Enterprise Applications and Business Systems
  
* Provide ongoing support and lifecycle management for business applications and systems, including requirements, selection, implementation, configuration, integration, upgrades, support and retirement.
* Manage application performance, availability and supportability so business users can obtain maximum value from the technology in use.
* Establish and maintain application ownership, support models, roadmaps, inventories, licensing records, technical dependencies and recovery requirements.
* Coordinate application testing, release planning, upgrades, production changes, vendor fixes and post\-implementation support.
* Evaluate new software and services against business, technical, security, privacy, accessibility, integration and total\-cost requirements.


Service Delivery, Incident and Problem Management
  
* Lead application support, service desk and end\-user service activities, including workload prioritization, escalations and service\-quality oversight.
* Establish service standards, escalation paths, ticket priorities, service\-level expectations and consistent customer communication practices.
* Act as the senior escalation point for major incidents, complex application problems, service interruptions and high\-priority business issues.
* Coordinate technical and vendor resources during outages and ensure stakeholders receive timely, clear and accurate updates.
* Maintain knowledge articles, support procedures, troubleshooting guides and self\-service resources.


Business Partnership, Process Improvement and Training
  
* Act as a liaison between IT and business teams to understand operational needs and translate them into practical application and technology solutions.
* Review business and support processes, identify inefficiencies and develop plans that improve productivity, service quality and cost\-effectiveness.
* Facilitate requirements gathering, process mapping, solution evaluation, user acceptance testing and implementation planning.
* Develop training initiatives, user documentation and change\-support materials that help employees adopt new systems and processes successfully.
* Identify recurring manual work and implement automation using PowerShell, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot, n8n workflow tools and other appropriate technologies.


People Leadership and Work Management
  
* Lead, coach and develop internal, remote and external technical\-support resources.
* Assign work, establish priorities and balance operational support with projects, maintenance, security

new_jobs.title: IT Systems Administrator
new_jobs.description:
Craving a challenging and rewarding career in a place you actually love? Perfect. Demetres was founded in 1989, and we're the premier destination for desserts in Toronto. With our 12 restaurant locations, 5 ice cream boutiques, our own central production facility, and a growing retail CPG presence, we are innovators in our field. For decades we have set the very definition of dessert experience. Our greatest years are yet to come, and we're looking for the best people to take us there.

 **About The Role**



We're looking for an IT Systems Administrator who is a pro at automation, building the scripts, integrations, and internal tools we use every day. At the same time, this is a high ownership, deeply hands\-on role for a technical generalist.  



  

That ranges from the POS terminal dropping offline at 9:30 PM on a packed Saturday to the new GM needing their account provisioned before their first shift, all the way to the automation that replaces a manual check nobody should still be doing. We need someone who can identify problems, fix them, and design the systems that keep them from coming back.

  

You'll work in a small tech team alongside our existing IT teammate, who covers a lot of the day\-to\-day support and hardware ground with you, and you'll partner closely with our maintenance and operations teams. You'll report into senior leadership, and you'll be trusted to ensure everything runs efficiently.

 **Key Responsibilities**


* Build internal tools and automations that remove manual work. Python, Google Apps Script, JavaScript, AI\-assisted code, whatever fits the problem. Small tools that quietly save hours every week are the highest\-value thing you can do here
* Support the accuracy and consistency of core data recipes, inventory, labour rules. You'll make them accurate, consistent, and actually useful, including the reporting and dashboards that leadership and store teams rely on
* Own the end\-user environment. Windows and Mac hardware, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and our core SaaS platforms provisioning, access, and support
* Maintain and support our POS infrastructure (Oracle Simphony), including POS backend servers and front\-of\-house terminals across all locations
* Manage our networks across every site. Patch panels, switches, LAN, wireless access points, and site\-to\-site VPNs.
* Be reachable during restaurant hours, including evenings and weekends. This is real and worth being clear about: our stores run late, and when something breaks mid\-service it's a guest\-experience problem, not a ticket. The vast majority get resolved remotely over Slack or a quick FaceTime call, but the expectation of availability is genuine
* Write things down. SOPs, documentation, and training resources, so our systems are operable by more than one person including the tools you build

  


**Required Skills and Qualifications**


* Comfort working with APIs, data, and other people's systems reading documentation, handling auth, dealing with formats that clash, and getting two platforms to talk
* Enough hands\-on technical range to be comfortable with hardware, workstations, and admin consoles, and the proven ability to learn when confronted with something new
* The independence to locate issues and work without a roadmap.
* Access to reliable transportation; this role is based out of our head office but requires regular travel to our locations across the GTA

  


**The X\-Factor (What Really Gets Us Excited)**


* You fix things permanently. When something breaks twice, you treat the second time as a design problem, not a support ticket
* You automate yourself out of your own busy work, and then go find more interesting problems to work on
* You think in systems and SOPs, not heroics. The goal isn't to be the only person who knows how something works
* You're equally happy in a terminal window, in a network closet, and in a meeting with senior leadership

  


**Here's what you get from us**


* Real autonomy over the entire technology environment of a vertically integrated dessert company, and unusual freedom to decide what to build
* Variety no two days are the same, and the surface area is genuinely large
* Ownership you can point at. The tools you build here will be used by hundreds of people, daily, for years
* A collaborative, no\-politics environment with a small senior team
* Working for a brand that delivers happiness (people gush when you tell them where you work)
* A healthy and flexible work\-life balance, with a supportive management team

  



Our Corporate Head Office is in Vaughan, located on Strada Drive near Highway 7 \& Pine Valley (close to Hwy 400 \& Hwy 407\). This role is full time and predominantly based out of our head office, and will require visits to our Demetres and Scooped by Demetres locations across the GTA.

 **To Apply**



Please submit a resume and a brief cover letter where you tell us a little about what you'd like to bring to our small team. If you've built internal tools, automations, scripts, or documentation you're proud of, show us — a repo, a screenshot, a description of the problem and what you did about it. Anything that will tell us more than a list of technologies. Fit matters to us, as we know having the right person will make a world of difference.

  

Thank you!

 *Please note, while we appreciate all candidates, only those chosen for an interview will be contacted.*
